comment: profiles.list result. Row shape methods_profiles.py:216-276; top-level keys are exactly {profiles, bot_mode_protocol} (:277-284, the flag is hardcoded True and never sent as false). The three rows carry the three preferred_session states the tri-state exists for, and they are NOT interchangeable: `default` has the key with an object (the caller pinned it and it resolved), `work` has the key with null (the caller pinned it and the row is gone / archived / kanban-or-tool sourced, :93-98), `research` has NO key at all (the caller supplied no pin for it, or the gateway is too old to answer — :234-236 writes the key only for a non-empty caller pin). default's preferred_session is the post-compression shape: root_title has gone empty and the title has moved to the tip, so id != resolved_id (hermes_state.py:8829-8859). last_session (:174-181) has six keys — no resolved_id, no root_title — and can never be the Bot Chat, because its lookup omits include_hidden (:159-161) and canonical chats are born hidden (filter at hermes_state.py:9486). ui_meta is present only when profile.yaml carries a non-empty dict (:238-263); ui_meta_revisions is always present and is the feature-detect for gateway-owned CAS.
